help.setup: Click any free intersection to place your first building: a port on the coast, a castle inside. It is free.
help.play: Click a mark in the middle of a cell side to build a road (it must start at your building or road). Click a circle on an intersection to build a settlement next to your road, promote it, trade at a port or move a settlement along a road. Buildings collect from the 4 cells around them when their number is rolled. Esc cancels.
